subclassFeature.name: Blood Knight
entries: Blood Knights are warriors who have learned to channel their own vital essence in combat, blending martial mastery with dark arts of hemomancy.

subclassFeature.name: Blood Tradition
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill History}, {@skill Religion}, or {@skill Arcana}. Additionally, your hit point maximum increases by 3, and increases by 1 whenever you gain a level in this class.

subclassFeature.name: Hemomancy
entries: You gain the ability to cast hemomancy spells using your {@b Constitution} as your spellcasting ability.
You regain your spell slots after a long rest, but you can regain one spell slot during a short rest once per day.
Spell save DC = {@dc 8+pb+con}. Spell attack modifier = {@hit pb+con}.
You know two 1st-level hemomancy spells of your choice. The table shows how many spell slots you have and their level.

subclassFeature.name: Fusion Techniques
entries: When you activate a fusion technique using {@i Blood Fusion}, it remains active. Changing techniques deals extra self-damage. At level 3, you gain:

items: Increase your reach with weapon attacks by 5 feet.
You can imbue your weapon with an element: Fire, Cold, Poison, Lightning, or Necrotic.
You can move without provoking opportunity attacks from a creature you have attacked this turn.

subclassFeature.name: Blood Binding
entries: When hitting with your fused weapon, you can use a {@action bonus action} and take {@damage 2d8} self-damage to curse the enemy.
The creature cannot move more than 30 feet away from you without taking {@damage 2d6} psychic damage (DC {@dc 8+pb+cha} save to halve damage and break the link).
You can teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to the target as part of one of your attacks.
The target cannot hide from you, and even if it becomes invisible, you always know its location.

subclassFeature.name: Blood Track
entries: You can discern the exact location of a creature if you possess a blood sample or if it is affected by your Blood Binding.
You add your {@b Charisma} modifier to Investigation or Perception checks to search for it. You have advantage on checks if it is affected by the link.
You take {@damage 1d6} damage for every mile traveled while maintaining the connection.

subclassFeature.name: Body Regeneration
entries: Your body has hardened. You can reduce self-damage from {@i Blood Fusion}, {@i Blood Binding}, or switching techniques by an amount equal to your {@b Constitution} modifier.
You can use this reduction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Starting at this level, you can apply {@i Blood Fusion} damage a second time per turn.

subclassFeature.name: Binding Augmented
entries: You add your {@b Charisma} modifier to the damage dealt against the creature affected by your Blood Binding.

subclassFeature.name: Superior Binding
entries: You can make an extra attack as part of your Attack action against the enemy affected by your Blood Binding.
Additionally, as a reaction, you can increase your AC by an amount equal to half the cost of activating your current fusion (minimum +1).

subclassFeature.name: Blood Ecstasy
entries: As a {@action bonus action}, you take {@damage 10d6} damage to enter an ecstatic state for 1 minute:

items: Resistance to all damage except Radiant and Psychic.
You can use {@classFeature Action Surge|Fighter|PHB|2} a third time.
You gain +10 feet of movement speed.
If you drop to 0 HP, you regain 1 HP and a full action immediately, ending the ecstatic state.

subclassFeature.name: College of Healing
entries: Bards of the College of Healing weave magic to mend wounds and cure diseases, enhancing the recovery of their allies on the battlefield.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency with the {@item herbalism kit|PHB}, {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}, and the {@skill Medicine} skill. If you already have proficiency in any of these, choose another skill or tool proficiency instead.

subclassFeature.name: Remedy Lore
entries: You can stabilize a creature at 0 hit points using a {@action bonus action} or an {@action action}.
Additionally, you can learn spells from the following list as bard spells:

entries.caption: Healing Spells
rows: {@spell detect poison and disease}, {@spell purify food and drink}
{@spell beacon of hope}, {@spell mass healing word}, {@spell revivify}

subclassFeature.name: Bedside Manner
entries: Each creature holding a {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|PHB|1} die granted by you has advantage on death saving throws.

When a creature succeeds on a death saving throw, it can roll that Bardic Inspiration die to regain {@dice 1d8} (or its current die type) hit points, gaining temporary hit points equal to the die's maximum value minus the roll result.

subclassFeature.name: Arcane First Aid
entries: You can cast {@spell lesser restoration} and {@spell cure wounds} (at a spell level equal to half your proficiency bonus) without expending a spell slot.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). You regain spent uses after a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Rhythm of Recovery
entries: When you cast a 1st-level or higher bard spell that does not restore hit points, one creature within 30 feet that can hear you regains hit points equal to your bard level divided by 4.
Your Bedside Manner and {@classFeature Song of Rest|Bard|PHB|2} features increase healing by an amount equal to your Charisma modifier.

When you cast a spell that restores hit points, you trigger a healing rhythm until your next turn; any creature you heal during this time regains additional hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of the Blood
entries: While most paladins pledge their swords to righteous deities, honor, or sworn protection, paladins of the Oath of the Blood are guided by raw, primal vitality and martial dominance. Born from ancient, perilous hemomancy, only those with iron discipline can command this blood-fueled power without being consumed by it, transforming themselves into indomitable warriors.

subclassFeature.name: Tenets of the Blood
entries: {@i (3rd-level Oath of the Blood feature)}
The tenets of blood are held with unyielding resolve, as giving in to frenzy leads to mindless destruction:

entries.name: Bleed and Triumph
entries: No matter how much blood you must shed, you must never lose command of your mind. Channel your vital essence to lead your comrades to victory.

entries.name: No Negotiations with Corruption
entries: Dark entities will seek to exploit your blood-bought power. Give them neither quarter nor compromise; destroy them without hesitation.

entries.name: Remember Your Humanity
entries: You are not a monstrous predator of the night; you are a champion of the mortal realm, and your strength exists to protect it.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: {@i (3rd-level Oath of the Blood feature)}
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity
entries: {@i (3rd-level Oath of the Blood feature)}
When you take this oath at 3rd level, you gain the following two Channel Divinity options:

entries.name: Draining Strike
entries: Immediately after you deal damage to a creature with your {@classFeature Divine Smite|Paladin|PHB|2} feature, you can use your Channel Divinity as a {@action bonus action} to distribute vitality to creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you (including yourself). The total number of hit points you distribute equals half the damage dealt by the smite attack (rounded down).

entries.name: Bloody Weapon
entries: As a {@action bonus action}, you coat your weapon in empowered vital essence, sacrificing {@damage 1d8} hit points to enhance its edge. For 1 minute, the weapon deals extra damage equal to the sacrificed roll. Additionally, the first target hit takes {@damage 1d4} piercing damage at the start of each of its turns from lingering bleeding, until a creature uses an action to tend the wound with a {@skill Medicine} check against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha} and a basic bandage. Your weapon counts as magical for the duration.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Blood
entries: {@i (7th-level Oath of the Blood feature)}

Starting at 7th level, you can radiate an overwhelming wave of crimson dread. As an {@action action}, each hostile creature within 10 feet of you must make an {@savingThrow Intelligence} saving throw against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d12} psychic damage. You gain temporary hit points equal to half the total damage dealt. Once you use this action, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Absorb Life
entries: {@i (15th-level Oath of the Blood feature)}

Starting at 15th level, whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee weapon attack or melee spell attack, you can use your {@action reaction} to gain temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level. These temporary hit points last until you finish a long rest. While you have these temporary hit points, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) and regain all expended uses after finishing a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Ichor
entries: {@i (20th-level Oath of the Blood feature)}

At 20th level, you can unleash a terrifying avatar of sanguinary power. As an {@action action}, you expend {@damage 2d12} hit points to project a circle of flowing vital energy in a 30-foot radius centered on you for 1 minute, gaining the following benefits:

items: Hostile creatures treat the area within 30 feet of you as difficult terrain, regardless of flying, swimming, or hovering.
Wings of solid crimson manifest from your back, granting you a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

When a creature within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your {@action reaction} to cause another creature within 30 feet to take the same amount of necrotic, psychic, or radiant damage (your choice).
Your melee attacks deal an extra {@damage 2d12} necrotic, psychic, or radiant damage (your choice).

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of Twilight
entries: Paladins who take the Oath of Twilight walk the fine line between radiant dawn and encroaching shadow, standing as vigilant sentinels on the threshold of mortal life and dark realms.

subclassFeature.name: Tenets of Twilight
entries: The tenets of the Oath of Twilight guide a paladin along the edge of darkness:

entries.name: Hold the Horizon
entries: Darkness is inevitable, but so is the dawn. Stand steadfast between them and protect those who cannot protect themselves.

entries.name: Walk Without Fear
entries: Enter the deepest shadows without fear, for your presence brings the guiding light of dusk.

entries.name: Mercy in the Gloom
entries: Do not blindly strike down those enveloped by despair; offer rest to weary souls and relentless retribution only to true evils.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the Oath of Twilight Spells table. Once you gain access to an oath spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

subclassFeature.name: Veil of Darkness
entries: As an {@action action}, you summon the Veil, cloaking yourself in an ebony, translucent mantle of twilight armor.

While active: You ignore resistance or immunity to necrotic damage. Additionally, you can choose to have your {@classFeature Divine Smite|Paladin|PHB|2} deal necrotic damage instead of radiant damage.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity
entries: You gain the following two Channel Divinity options:

entries.name: Bulwark of Light
entries: As an {@action action}, you present your holy symbol and utter a word of tranquil solace. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you gain temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d10} + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

entries.name: Chains of Justice
entries: As an {@action action}, you manifest ethereal chains of twilight energy to bind an enemy. A creature you can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@savingThrow Dexterity} saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, twilight chains wrap around it; until the start of your next turn, the creature cannot move farther away from you by any means.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Twilight
entries: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have resistance to necrotic and radiant damage. In addition, dim light does not impose disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks for you and friendly creatures in this aura.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Twilight Shroud
entries: Starting at 15th level, you can step freely across thresholds of shadow. When you are in dim light or darkness, you can use a {@action bonus action} to magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.
Additionally, while your Veil of Darkness is active, you gain a +2 bonus to AC and advantage on Dexterity saving throws as shadows obscure your movements.

subclassFeature.name: Avatar of Twilight
entries: At 20th level, you can take on the mantle of the Twilight Harbinger, an embodiment of the sacred boundary between light and darkness. As an {@action action}, you undergo a transformation for 1 minute, gaining the following benefits:

items: A 30-foot radius sphere of soothing twilight emanates from you. Bright light within this sphere becomes dim light, and magical darkness within it is dispelled.
You and friendly creatures inside the aura have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.
Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d8} radiant or necrotic damage (your choice).
You gain a flying speed of 60 feet and can hover.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Pale Master
entries: Your powers are necromantic in origin, your flesh petrified and corrupted. You are a living mind trapped within a decaying corpse.

subclassFeature.name: Deathsign
entries: You are marked with death. Whenever you would normally take necrotic damage from a spell of 1st level or higher, you instead regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt (rounded down).
Additionally, you learn bonus necromancy spells that do not count against your total number of sorcerer spells known:

items: {@b 1st:} {@spell inflict wounds}
{@b 3rd:} {@spell ray of enfeeblement}
{@b 5th:} {@spell animate dead}
{@b 7th:} {@spell blight}
{@b 9th:} {@spell contagion}
{@b 11th:} {@spell create undead}

subclassFeature.name: Undead Cohort
entries: You can control undead creatures under your command. You can control a maximum number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus.
The maximum Challenge Rating (CR) of an undead cohort cannot exceed half your sorcerer level (rounded down).
Maintaining control requires spending sorcery points each day according to the table:
Each day at dawn, you must make a Constitution check (DC 10 + highest CR + Wisdom modifier of your Undead Cohort) to maintain control over your cohort.

subclassFeature.name: Emissary of Death
entries: Whenever you deal damage with a necromancy spell, you can add your {@b Charisma} modifier to the damage roll.
When you do so, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain {@dice 1d10} temporary hit points.

subclassFeature.name: Spellstitched Cohort
entries: Your cohort improves. It learns one necromancy cantrip of your choice which it can cast on its turn using your sorcerer level.
Additionally, your Deathsign extends to your cohorts: whenever one of them receives necrotic damage from a non-cantrip source, it instead regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage taken.

subclassFeature.name: Overlord
entries: At 18th level, when you cast {@spell animate dead} to reassert control over undead, you can spend sorcery points to cast it as if using a spell slot one level higher for each point spent.

subclassFeature.name: Phoenix Sorcery
entries: In a world shrouded by the encroaching shadows of the Black Dawn, true light has withered and ancient flames have grown cold. Yet beneath mountains of ash, the primordial spark of the Phoenix refuses to die. Your innate power derives from this undying flame—an eternal fire that hungers to be rekindled through destruction and miraculous rebirth. While others fear the dark, you carry within your veins the fierce, burning heart of a dying sun.

subclassFeature.name: Phoenix Magic
entries: You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Phoenix Spells table. Each spell counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.
Additionally, you learn the {@spell control flames|xge} cantrip. It counts as a sorcerer cantrip for you, but it doesn't count against your number of cantrips known.

subclassFeature.name: Ignite
entries: At 1st level, you gain the ability to start fires with a touch. As a bonus action or an action, you can magically ignite an unattended flammable object you touch with your hand—such as a torch, a piece of tinder, a campfire, or the hem of drapes.

subclassFeature.name: Mantle of Flame
entries: Starting at 1st level, you can awaken the dormant ember of the phoenix burning within your soul.
As a bonus action, you magically wreathe yourself in swirling fire, soot, and incandescent embers. For 1 minute, you gain the following benefits:

items: You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.
Any creature takes fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) if it hits you with a melee attack from within 5 feet of you or if it touches you.
Once per turn, when you roll fire damage for a sorcerer spell or feature, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.
You have resistance to fire damage.

entries: You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. You can also expend 2 sorcery points to use this feature again.

subclassFeature.name: Phoenix Spark
entries: Starting at 6th level, the fiery energy within you surges outward to preserve your life in the face of defeat.

If you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to draw upon the spark of the phoenix. You are instead reduced to 1 hit point, and each creature within 10 feet of you takes fire damage equal to your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier.

If you use this feature while under the effects of your Mantle of Flame, each creature instead takes fire damage equal to twice your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier, and your Mantle of Flame immediately ends.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Cinder Soul
entries: Also starting at 6th level, the eternal fire permanently fuses with your physical form and spirit. You gain permanent resistance to fire damage.
In addition, spells you cast ignore resistance to fire damage.

subclassFeature.name: Nourishing Fire
entries: Starting at 14th level, your destructive fire feeds and sustains your mortal frame. When you expend a spell slot or sorcery points to cast a spell of 1st level or higher that deals fire damage, you regain hit points equal to the slot's level (or sorcery points expended) + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).
Additionally, you can choose one friendly creature you can see within 30 feet of you; that creature regains hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Form of the Phoenix
entries: At 18th level, you master the primordial avatar of the phoenix. While your Mantle of Flame feature is active, you gain the following benefits:

items: Blazing wings of incandescent flame and dark ash sprout from your back, granting you a flying speed of 40 feet and the ability to hover.
You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and immunity to fire damage.
If you use your Phoenix Spark feature, that feature deals an extra 20 fire damage to each affected creature, and you regain hit points equal to half your hit point maximum.

subclassFeature.name: Rogue of Blood
entries: While other rogues hone their silver tongues or deft pickpocketing, your vital essence has been awakened—blessed or cursed by a mysterious power. By channeling the vitality flowing through your veins, you transform your blood into razor-sharp projectiles and lethal hexes.
Rogues of this path wield their own life force in battle with terrifying precision, though careless hemomancers risk perishing from their own sacrificial arts.

subclassFeature.name: Bloody Tradition
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice, reflecting the origins of your sanguine craft: {@skill History}, {@skill Religion}, or {@skill Arcana}.
In addition, your hit point maximum increases by 2, and increases by 1 whenever you gain a level in this class after 3rd level, reflecting your enhanced physical resilience.

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Draft
entries: At 3rd level, as a {@action bonus action}, you can spend {@damage 1d6} of your own hit points to coat a bladed weapon or a piece of ammunition (arrow, bolt, or bullet) in your vital essence for 1 minute, giving it a jagged, crystalline edge.

When a serrated melee weapon hits a target, the creature takes {@damage 1d4} necrotic bleed damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an action to tend the wound with a {@skill Medicine} check against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha} and a basic bandage.

When a serrated ranged projectile hits a target, it embeds deeply in flesh. Any attempt to extract the projectile deals {@damage 1d6} slashing damage to the target as its barbed teeth tear tissue, and causes {@damage 1d6} bleed damage at the start of each of its turns until tended with a {@skill Medicine} check against DC {@dc 8+pb+cha} and a basic bandage.
Creatures without blood (such as constructs or incorporeal undead) are immune to this bleeding damage.
At 9th level, the melee bleed damage increases to {@dice 2d4}, and extracting a ranged projectile deals {@dice 2d6} slashing damage plus {@dice 2d6} bleed damage.

subclassFeature.name: Changing the Odds
entries: Starting at 9th level, you can escape or engage danger with sudden, violent redirection. As a {@action bonus action}, you expend {@damage 2d10} hit points to vanish in a burst of sanguine mist, teleporting to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet.

Each creature within 10 feet of your departure point must make a {@savingThrow Dexterity} saving throw against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha}, taking {@damage 4d10} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Versatile Projectile
entries: At 13th level, your control over sanguine ammunition allows you to debilitate your prey. When you hit a creature with a weapon enhanced by Crimson Draft, it must succeed on a {@savingThrow Constitution} saving throw against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha} or become {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.
Additionally, when you activate Crimson Draft, you can alter the bleed damage type to your choice of psychic, acid, or necrotic damage.

subclassFeature.name: Hemorrhage
entries: At 17th level, when you deal 50 or more damage to a single creature on your turn with a weapon attack and that creature has 100 hit points or fewer remaining, you can use a {@action bonus action} to force that creature to make a {@savingThrow Constitution} saving throw against your spell save DC {@dc 8+pb+cha}.
On a failed save, the creature's blood turns against it; its hit points immediately drop to 0 and it falls {@condition unconscious}.
You can use this feature twice, regaining all expended uses after a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Bloodtouched
entries: Your magic stems from a cursed bloodline or a forbidden ritual that altered your very essence.

subclassFeature.name: Bloodsign
entries: You learn bonus spells automatically based on your sorcerer level:

items: {@b 1st:} {@spell Bloodburn|dapc}
{@b 3rd:} {@spell Vampire's Kiss|dapc}
{@b 5th:} {@spell Tides of Blood|dapc}
{@b 7th:} {@spell Draining thread|dapc}
{@b 9th:} {@spell Bloodcurse|dapc}
{@b 11th:} {@spell Rain of Blood|dapc}

subclassFeature.name: Blood Tradition
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill History}, {@skill Religion}, or {@skill Arcana}. Additionally, your hit point maximum increases by 3, and increases by 1 whenever you gain a level in this class after level 3.

subclassFeature.name: Thirst for Blood
entries: Once per turn, when you kill one or more creatures that possess blood using a spell of 1st level or higher, you regain hit points equal to three times the spell's level.

subclassFeature.name: Superior Blood Tradition
entries: Starting at 6th level, you add your {@b Constitution} modifier to all saving throws you make.

subclassFeature.name: Overwhelming Power
entries: Your body can push past mortal limits. Once per turn, if you took the Attack action, you can deal {@damage 6} + your proficiency bonus + your {@b Constitution} modifier as a bonus action and take half of that damage yourself.
If you do so, you can make a second Attack action this turn. At 18th level, you can use this feature one additional time per turn (two times total).

subclassFeature.name: Master of Blood
entries: For 5 sorcery points or half your current hit points (as long as you have more than 20 HP), you control a corpse or unconscious creature within 30 feet. This creature shares your initiative and has its own action, bonus action, and reaction.
The creature regains hit points equal to your level × {@dice 1d4}. Upon death, its soul cannot be restored. While active, you gain the following benefits:

items: Advantage on {@b Constitution} saving throws.
One-quarter of the hit points restored become temporary hit points for you.
You regain one spell slot of 4th level or lower.

subclassFeature.name: Tricks Up the Sleeve
entries: You learn the {@spell guidance} cantrip.

entries.name: Level 9 Upgrade
entries: Starting at 9th level, this spell has a range of 30 feet for you and you can cast it as a bonus action.

subclassFeature.name: Wildcard's Gambit
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Gaming Set|PHB|playing cards}. You have access to the {@item Deck of Cards|WildCardHomebrew} weapon and its {@item Card|WildCardHomebrew} ammunition. You can use an enchanted card to make a ranged weapon attack (60 ft range). The attack uses your Dexterity modifier and deals damage based on your level.
This card counts as a weapon with the Finesse property for applying your {@classFeature Sneak Attack|Rogue|PHB|1}.
You have a number of uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) per long rest.

entries.name: Wildcard Effects Table (Save DC = 8 + Proficiency + Charisma Mod)
items: {@b 1. Dagger (Level 3):} If you apply Sneak Attack, the target takes extra slashing damage equal to half your Sneak Attack damage at the start of its next turn.
{@b 2. Chains (Level 3):} Target must make a {@savingThrow Strength} or {@savingThrow Dexterity} save or become {@condition grappled} until your next turn.
{@b 3. Heart (Level 3):} Regain HP equal to half Sneak Attack damage (excess becomes temporary HP).
{@b 4. Frost (Level 6):} Target has disadvantage on attack rolls during its next turn.
{@b 5. The Crown (Level 6):} Target must make a {@savingThrow Wisdom} save or use its reaction to attack an ally of your choice.
{@b 7. Death (Level 9):} If target has 30 HP or lower, it must pass a {@savingThrow Constitution} save or die instantly; if successful, it is {@condition paralyzed}.
{@b 8. The Wheel (Level 13):} Target must pass a {@savingThrow Dexterity} save or fall {@condition prone}.
{@b 10. Judgment (Level 17):} Target must pass a {@savingThrow Wisdom} save or become {@condition paralyzed} and gain vulnerability to all damage.

subclassFeature.name: Shift the Odds
entries: As a bonus action, creatures within 10 feet make a {@savingThrow Dexterity} save (DC 8 + Proficiency + Charisma Mod) or take {@damage 6d10} force damage and fall {@condition prone}. Then you teleport up to 60 feet.
You gain resistance to all damage and advantage on Dexterity saves until your next turn. Regained after a short or long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Twist of Fate
entries: You can swap initiative with a creature you can see. Enemies must make a {@savingThrow Wisdom} save (DC 8 + Proficiency + Charisma Mod).
You and an ally gain +10 ft speed and advantage on the first attack roll of combat.

subclassFeature.name: Joker's Wild
entries: As a bonus action, you enter an incorporeal form for 1 minute.

items: Regain spent uses of Wildcard's Gambit.
Doubled speed.
Resistance to all damage and immunity to {@condition grappled}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition stunned}, and {@condition restrained}.
You can move through objects and creatures. If you end inside a creature, it takes {@damage 1d10} force damage.

entries: Regained after a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Wild Card (2024)
entries: At 3rd level, you master the art of enchanting playing cards with lethal probability-warping magic, turning gambling into a deadly combat craft.

entries.name: Tricks Up the Sleeve
entries: You learn the {@spell guidance} cantrip (in D&D 2024, cast as a Reaction within 30 feet when a creature fails an ability check). Dexterity or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.
You gain proficiency with {@item Gaming Set|PHB|playing cards}. Additionally, you have advantage on Sleight of Hand and Insight checks made to manipulate or read card games.

entries.name: Wildcard's Gambit
entries: You channel magic into custom enchanted playing cards that you can throw as ranged weapons (Finesse, Light, 20/60 ft range, Slashing or Piercing damage) with the {@b Vex} weapon mastery property. The cards count as magical weapons.

You must craft your specialized cards using your playing card set during a short or long rest (2 hours of crafting). A pack of 20 cards costs 2 GP at level 3 (weighing 1 lb per 20 cards). You can carry a maximum of 25 prepared cards at a time. After combat, you can recover 50% of thrown cards.
Your card's base damage die and range scale with your Rogue level:

entries.caption: Base Damage, Range, and Crafting Cost by Level

entries: When you hit a creature with a card attack, you can expend 1 Gambit use to activate an extra effect from the Cards of Fate Table by rolling your Gambit die (1d4 at 3rd level, 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 9th level, 1d10 at 13th level). You have a number of Gambit uses equal to your Dexterity or Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) + 1 per short or long rest. You regain 1 use whenever you roll initiative.
The Save DC for your card effects equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Dexterity or Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Cards of Fate Table (Progressive 1d4 -> 1d10)
items: {@b 1. Shadow Blade (Level 3 - 1d4):} If you apply Sneak Attack, the target takes extra slashing damage equal to half your Sneak Attack damage at the start of its next turn.
{@b 2. Eclipse Shackles (Level 3 - 1d4):} Target must pass a Strength or Dexterity save or become {@condition grappled} until the start of your next turn.
{@b 3. Crimson Heart (Level 3 - 1d4):} If you apply Sneak Attack, regain HP equal to half Sneak Attack damage (excess becomes temporary HP).
{@b 4. Ravenous Frost (Level 6 - 1d6):} Target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

entries: You channel magic into custom enchanted playing cards that you can throw as ranged weapons (Finesse, Light, 20/60 ft range, Slashing or Piercing damage) with the {@b Vex} weapon mastery property. The cards count as magical weapons.

entries: As a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Creatures within 10 feet of your origin point must make a Dexterity save, taking {@damage 4d10} force damage and falling {@condition prone} on a failure, or half damage on a success.

Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance to all damage and advantage on Dexterity saving throws. Once used, you cannot use this feature again until you complete a short or long rest (or by expending 1 Gambit use).

subclassFeature.name: Twist of Fate
entries: You add your Charisma or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher) to your Initiative rolls.
When rolling initiative at the start of combat, you can swap your initiative count with a willing ally, or force an enemy within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save to swap initiative with them.
Both you and the selected ally gain +10 ft speed and advantage on your first attack roll of combat.

subclassFeature.name: Joker's Wild
entries: As a Bonus Action, you assume an incorporeal, probability-warping form for 1 minute.

Your movement speed is doubled, and you can move through objects and creatures as difficult terrain.

race.name: Kindred
entries: As a Kindred, your character has the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Your lifespan is influenced by your mortal lineage; if your mortal lineage dictates an age, use that expectancy. Otherwise, your spiritual lifespan extends up to 1,000 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Your alignment is often shaped by your mortal upbringing, but kindred are by nature neutral, walking the boundary between life and death.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Aided by the senses of the Wolf, you can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can discern colors in dim light.

entries.name: Death Mark
entries: At the start of combat, you can mark a target creature within 60 feet. The marked target takes 1 extra damage from each of your weapon attacks. When a marked target dies, you gain a death mark counter. For every 4 death marks you accumulate during a combat, your weapon attacks gain an extra 5 feet of range and deal 1 additional damage to marked targets. This counter resets when combat ends.

entries.name: Wolf
entries: The Wolf is your eternal guardian spirit, advising you and awakening in battle. The Wolf speaks Sylvan. Once per turn, you can command the Wolf to strike a marked target within 20 feet of you as a free action, dealing {@damage 1d4} + your Dexterity modifier in piercing damage. After the Wolf has downed 4 enemies, you regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d8} + your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Lamb's Respite
entries: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), regaining expended uses after a long rest.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Sylvan, and one extra language of your choice.

entries.name: Kindred
entries: Death is an inevitable force in the multiverse, commonly depicted as a solitary reaper with a scythe. But the true reapers of souls are the Kindred—a dual entity of Lamb and Wolf who hunt together. Bound as two halves of a single soul, Lamb grants peaceful departure with her arrows to those who accept their fate, while Wolf relentlessly runs down those who flee from their end.

race.name: Pureblood Vampire
entries: As a Vampire, your character has the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Vampires are immortal and do not age naturally. Vampires retain the physical appearance and biological maturity of the age at which they were turned.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Young vampires may struggle to maintain the moral convictions they had in life, but older vampires almost always gravitate toward Lawful Evil, abiding by centuries-old codes of aristocratic dominion and self-preservation.

entries.name: Size
entries: Vampires vary in height and build just as mortals do. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 35 feet, and you have a climbing speed of 35 feet.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: Your crimson eyes pierce the thickest gloom. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Blood Drinker
entries: Even though you are undead, you still require vital essence in the form of fresh blood to sustain your nocturnal existence. You are immune to disease, and you do not need to eat or breathe (though you can ingest food and drink, which tastes ash-like to you). If you go more than seven days without drinking at least one ration of blood, you suffer one level of exhaustion at midnight on the seventh day and each subsequent midnight. This exhaustion can only be removed by consuming blood. If you reach six levels of exhaustion due to this trait, you are destroyed.

entries.name: Vampiric Resistance
entries: You have resistance to necrotic and poison damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

entries.name: Bite
entries: All vampires possess elongated fangs capable of puncturing flesh. If a willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition charmed}, {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition restrained} within 5 feet of you has blood, you can use a {@action bonus action} to bite it. The bite deals {@damage 1d6} piercing damage plus necrotic damage equal to your Constitution modifier. Sating your hunger this way satisfies your Blood Drinker trait. When you use your Bite, you can choose to deal no damage.

entries.name: Child of Night
entries: You know the {@spell minor illusion} cantrip and can cast it at will. At 3rd level, you can cast {@spell charm person} once with this trait, regaining the ability to do so after a long rest. At 5th level, you can cast {@spell alter self} once with this trait, regaining the ability to do so after a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one additional language of your choice.

entries.name: Vampire Pureblood
entries: Pureblood vampires consider themselves the true aristocrats of the night. Predicated on harvesting vitality from mortal populations to fuel unnatural longevity, they weave intricate webs of political influence and forbidden occult mastery.

race.name: Qilin
entries: As a Qilin, your character has the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Qilin mature at the same rate as humans but can live for up to 1,000 years, retaining their vitality and sharp intellect throughout their lifespan.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Qilin revere harmony, truth, and scholarship, tending strongly toward Neutral Good. Evil Qilin are exceptionally rare.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 35 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Natural Weapon
entries: In your natural form, your bite is a natural weapon that you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to {@damage 1d4} + your Dexterity modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: You can use an {@action action} to exhale radiant cosmic energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@savingThrow Dexterity} saving throw (DC = {@dc 8+pb+con}). A creature takes {@damage 2d6} radiant damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases by {@damage 1d6} at 5th level, 11th level, and 17th level.

After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until it recharges. At the start of each of your turns after using it, you can roll a {@dice d6}. On a 6, you regain the use of your breath weapon. Alternatively, it recharges automatically after 1 minute out of combat.

entries.name: Magical Qilin
entries: You know the {@spell dancing lights} cantrip and can cast it at will. At 3rd level, you can cast {@spell charm person} once with this trait, regaining the ability to do so after a long rest. At 5th level, you can cast {@spell alter self} once with this trait, regaining the ability to do so after a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Sylvan.

entries.name: Qilin
entries: Like ancient celestial and fey beings, the Qilin are revered for their profound wisdom, benevolence, and serene presence. Often acting as counselors, diplomats, and sages in mortal courts, their rare appearance is considered a harbinger of prosperity and epochal change.

race.name: Siren
entries: As a Siren, your character has the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Sirens reach physical maturity around the age of 18. As fey beings bound to primordial magical waters, they do not suffer physical frailty from old age and can live up to 600 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Sirens embody the untamed, shifting nature of oceanic currents and the freedom of the Fey. Most lean toward Chaotic alignments, ranging from protective guides and reclusive reef-dwellers (Chaotic Good) to mercurial tricksters (Chaotic Neutral) or predatory temptresses of the dark abyss (Chaotic Evil).

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: Your creature type is Fey, rather than Humanoid.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to twilight mists and sunless oceanic trenches, you can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can discern colors in dim light.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe both air and water.

entries.name: Twofold Form (Shapechanger)
entries: As a {@action bonus action}, or automatically when you submerge yourself in water or dry off on land, you can shift your lower body between a pair of humanoid legs and a sleek, scaled aquatic tail:

items: {@b Tail Form:} While in your tail form, your swimming speed increases to 40 feet, and you have advantage on {@skill Dexterity} ({@skill Acrobatics}) and {@skill Strength} ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to swim or maneuver underwater. On land, your walking speed is reduced to 5 feet.
{@b Legged Form:} While in your legged form, your walking speed is 30 feet, and your swimming speed is 30 feet.

entries: Any clothing or armor you wear magically adapts to your form or safely unfastens itself without being damaged (your choice).

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Alluring Grace
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

entries.name: Siren's Magic
entries: You know the {@spell shape water|xge} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast {@spell charm person} once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it when you finish a long rest. Starting at 5th level, you can cast {@spell enthrall} once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

entries.name: Siren's Call
entries: As an {@action action}, you can project a captivating vocal melody toward a humanoid or beast you can see within 30 feet of you that can hear you. The target must succeed on a {@savingThrow Wisdom} saving throw (DC = {@dc 8+pb+cha}) or become {@condition charmed} by you until the end of your next turn.

While {@condition charmed} in this way, the target's speed is halved, and on its turn it can only use its movement to move toward you by the safest available route. The effect ends early if the target takes any damage.
You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Sylvan, and Aquan.

entries.name: Siren
entries: In the world of the Black Dawn, where sunlight has been blotted out and the skies hang heavy with gloom, the misty seas, cenotes, and subterranean grottoes belong to the Sirens. These aquatic fey beings are both enchanting and perilous, their haunting songs echoing across the water to bewitch travelers, protect sacred springs, or lure treacherous predators to the deep.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Moonbeam Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a pulse of freezing moonlight in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) cold damage and is {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (the creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success). On a successful save, the creature takes half the cold damage and is not blinded.

bonus.name: Phase (3/Day)
entries: The dragon becomes partially incorporeal for as long as it maintains {@status concentration} on the effect (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). While partially incorporeal, the dragon has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Treacherous Ice
entries: Magical ice covers the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of itself. The ice, which is difficult terrain for all creatures except lunar dragons, lasts for 10 minutes or until the dragon uses this legendary action again.

legendary.name: Full Moon (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon casts {@spell moonbeam} (DC 21, +13 to hit) without components, targeting a point it can see within 120 feet.

trait.name: One With the Forest
entries: While in forest terrain, difficult terrain does not slow Sylveth's movement. Plants within 120 feet of Sylveth obey its will; it can use a bonus action to cause any nonmagical plant in this area to create difficult terrain, or to clear it.

trait.name: Camouflage, Forest
entries: Sylveth has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in forested or heavily vegetated terrain.

trait.name: Primordial Blood
entries: Sylveth cannot be surprised, charmed, or frightened. It has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Sylveth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Sylveth deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sylveth makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d8 + 10}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Thorn Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: Sylveth releases a burst of magical thorns and toxic spores in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 49 ({@damage 14d6}) piercing damage plus 49 ({@damage 14d6}) poison damage and is {@condition restrained} by thorny vines until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half the damage and is not restrained.

action.name: Summon Vines (Recharge 6)
entries: Sylveth calls upon the forest itself. Grasping roots and vines erupt in a 30-foot-radius area centered on a point Sylveth can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or become {@condition restrained}. A restrained creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, freeing itself on a success. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute.

legendary.name: Tail Strike
entries: Sylveth makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Entangle (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Sylveth casts {@spell entangle} (DC 22) without components, centered on a point it can see within 120 feet.

legendary.name: Primordial Roar (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Sylveth releases a roar that predates civilization. Each hostile creature within 90 feet that can hear Sylveth must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to Sylveth's Primordial Roar for 24 hours.

trait.name: Aura de Vida Marchita
entries: Las criaturas hostiles a 15 pies de Osvin no pueden recuperar puntos de golpe por ninguna vía.
Si una criatura intenta conjurar un hechizo de curación dentro del aura, la curación falla y el lanzador recibe {@damage 1d8} de daño necrótico por cada nivel del hechizo intentado.

trait.name: Carcelero Implacable
entries: Osvin tiene ventaja en las tiradas de salvación contra ser asustado, paralizado o apresado.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Osvin realiza dos ataques con su Mandoble del Carcelero o dos ataques con las Cadenas del Cepo.

action.name: Mandoble del Carcelero
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Cadenas del Cepo
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage y el objetivo queda {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).
Mientras esté apresado, el objetivo sufre 9 ({@damage 2d8}) de daño necrótico al inicio de cada uno de sus turnos. Osvin puede tener hasta dos criaturas apresadas simultáneamente.

bonus.name: Bofetada de Culpa
entries: Osvin señala a una criatura a 30 pies y se burla de sus pérdidas. El objetivo debe superar una tirada de salvación de Sabiduría {@dc 14} o sufrir desventaja en su siguiente tirada de ataque y recibir 7 ({@damage 2d6}) de daño psíquico.

reaction.name: Escudo del Recluso
entries: Cuando una criatura golpea a Osvin con un ataque y Osvin tiene al menos una criatura apresada con sus cadenas, transfiere la mitad del daño recibido a la criatura apresada.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: Si Vesna es sometida a un efecto que le permite realizar una tirada de salvación de Destreza para recibir la mitad del daño, en su lugar no recibe ningún daño si supera la tirada, y solo la mitad si falla.

trait.name: Paso de la Muerte Larga
entries: El movimiento de Vesna no provoca ataques de oportunidad, y puede moverse a través del espacio de cualquier criatura enemiga.

trait.name: Toque Macabro
entries: Cuando Vesna reduce a una criatura a 0 puntos de golpe con un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo, gana 15 puntos de golpe temporales.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vesna realiza cuatro ataques con su Puño Silencioso, o dos ataques de Puño Silencioso y un Quiebre de Vástago si está disponible.

action.name: Puño Silencioso
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Quiebre de Vástago (Recarga 5–6)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage y el objetivo debe realizar una tirada de salvación de Constitución {@dc 17}. Si falla, queda {@condition paralyzed} hasta el final de su siguiente turno. Si supera la salvación, recibe la mitad del daño y no queda paralizado.

reaction.name: Desvío de Golpes
entries: Vesna reduce el daño de un ataque de arma cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia que la impacte en 1d10 + 15. Si el daño se reduce a 0, Vesna puede teletransportarse instantáneamente hasta 15 pies a un espacio desocupado que pueda ver.

trait.name: Comandante de Elyria Caída
entries: Los no-muertos aliados a 30 pies de Brannoch tienen ventaja en las tiradas de ataque contra cualquier criatura que se encuentre a 5 pies de Brannoch.

trait.name: Sol Calcinado
entries: Los ataques con armas de Brannoch están imbuidos de magia sacrílega, infligiendo 9 ({@damage 2d8}) de daño necrótico adicional en cada golpe (incluido en el ataque).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Brannoch realiza dos ataques con su Espada Larga Ducal y utiliza Mandato de Combate.

action.name: Espada Larga Ducal de Elyria
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

Si el objetivo es un elfo, dhampir o un paladín (como Nyx), el objetivo debe superar una tirada de salvación de Sabiduría {@dc 14} o sufrir desventaja en sus tiradas de ataque hasta el final de su siguiente turno por el peso espectral de sus recuerdos.

action.name: Mandato de Combate
entries: Brannoch elige a un aliado no-muerto a 30 pies que pueda verlo u oírlo. Ese aliado puede usar inmediatamente su reacción para realizar un ataque con arma con ventaja.

reaction.name: Parada del Mentor
entries: Brannoch añade +3 a su CA contra un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo que lo impactaría. Si el ataque falla, Brannoch puede realizar inmediatamente un ataque con su Espada Larga Ducal contra el atacante.

trait.name: Piel de Grimorio
entries: Ulric tiene ventaja en las tiradas de salvación contra conjuros y otros efectos mágicos.
Cuando recibe daño de un conjuro de mago, absorbe parte de la fórmula arcana: su siguiente ataque causa 7 ({@damage 2d6}) de daño de fuerza adicional.

trait.name: Lazo Visual con Graznagrís
entries: Mientras Graznagrís esté a menos de 100 pies de Ulric, Ulric no puede ser sorprendido ni flanqueado, y comparte los sentidos del cuervo.

spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de Conjuros (Mago 9º Nivel)
headerEntries: Ulric es un lanzador de conjuros de nivel 9. Su característica para el lanzamiento de conjuros es Inteligencia (salvación {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} al impacto de conjuros). Tiene preparados los siguientes conjuros de mago:

action.name: Pluma de Médula
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage y el objetivo queda {@condition blinded} por tinta arcana hasta el final de su siguiente turno a menos que supere una tirada de salvación de Constitución {@dc 15}.

monster.name: Graznagrís
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

trait.name: Vuelo Rápido
entries: Graznagrís puede realizar la acción de Destrabarse (Disengage) como acción adicional en cada uno de sus turnos.

trait.name: Mirada Carroñera
entries: Graznagrís tiene ventaja en las pruebas de Sabiduría (Percepción) que dependan de la vista.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Graznagrís realiza un ataque de Picotazo Podrido y un ataque de Garras Desgarradoras.

action.name: Picotazo Podrido
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Garras Desgarradoras
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
Si el objetivo es de tamaño Mediano o inferior, queda {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Hasta que este agarre termine, el objetivo queda inmovilizado y Graznagrís puede volar cargando con él.

action.name: Chillido de la Agonía (Recarga 5–6)
entries: Graznagrís emite un chillido estridente de muerte. Cada criatura en un cono de 30 pies debe realizar una tirada de salvación de Constitución {@dc 14}. Si falla, recibe 21 ({@damage 6d6}) de daño psíquico y queda {@condition deafened} por 1 minuto. Si supera la salvación, recibe la mitad del daño y no queda ensordecida.

spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de Conjuros Divinos (Clériga Nivel 11)
headerEntries: Ilse es una lanzadora de conjuros de nivel 11. Su característica para conjuros es Sabiduría (salvación {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} al impacto de conjuros). Tiene preparados los siguientes conjuros de clérigo:

action.name: Maza de la Traición
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Semilla de la Discordia (Recarga 5–6)
entries: Ilse susurra palabras de rencor dirigida a dos criaturas que sean aliadas entre sí a menos de 60 pies de ella. Cada objetivo debe superar una tirada de salvación de Sabiduría {@dc 16} o usar inmediatamente su reacción para realizar un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia contra su compañero con su arma más poderosa.

trait.name: Agresivo
entries: Como acción adicional, Grushnak puede moverse hasta su velocidad hacia una criatura hostil que pueda ver.

trait.name: Verdugo Implacable
entries: Los ataques con arma de Grushnak tienen ventaja contra cualquier criatura que tenga menos de la mitad de sus puntos de golpe máximos, e infligen 6 ({@damage 1d12}) de daño adicional a esos objetivos.

trait.name: Resistencia Legendaria (2/Día)
entries: Si Grushnak falla una tirada de salvación, puede elegir tener éxito en su lugar.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grushnak realiza tres ataques con su Hacha Decapitadora, o dos con el Hacha y uno con el Gancho de Tortura.

action.name: Hacha Decapitadora de Aspos
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) slashing damage. Este ataque consigue un impacto crítico con una tirada de 19 o 20 en el d20.

action.name: Gancho de Carne y Tortura
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage. El objetivo es arrastrado 10 pies hacia Grushnak y derribado al suelo ({@condition prone}).

legendary.name: Ataque de Gancho
entries: Grushnak realiza un ataque con su Gancho de Carne y Tortura.

legendary.name: Rugido Tiránico (Cuesta 2 Acciones)
entries: Grushnak ruge con ferocidad aterradora. Cada criatura a 30 pies debe superar una tirada de salvación de Sabiduría {@dc 16} o quedar {@condition frightened} hasta el final de su siguiente turno.

legendary.name: Comandar Tropas
entries: Un aliado de Grushnak a 30 pies puede usar su reacción para moverse hasta la mitad de su velocidad y realizar un ataque con arma.

trait.name: Cosecha Severa
entries: Cuando Morvaine mata a una criatura con un hechizo de nigromancia, recupera puntos de golpe iguales a tres veces el nivel del hechizo.

trait.name: Comandante de No-Muertos
entries: Los no-muertos bajo el control de Morvaine añaden +4 a sus tiradas de daño con armas y tienen 18 puntos de golpe adicionales.

spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de Conjuros (Maga 11º Nivel)
headerEntries: Morvaine es una lanzadora de conjuros de nivel 11 (salvación {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} al impacto de conjuros):

action.name: Daga de Hueso Hendido
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Resistencia Mágica
entries: Sskarith tiene ventaja en las tiradas de salvación contra conjuros y otros efectos mágicos.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sskarith realiza dos ataques con su Cimitarra Pesada y un ataque con su Mordisco de Serpiente, o un ataque de Constricción.

action.name: Cimitarra Pesada
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Mordisco de Serpiente
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage más 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage. El objetivo debe superar una salvación de Constitución {@dc 14} o quedar {@condition poisoned} por 1 minuto.

action.name: Constricción
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage y el objetivo queda {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) y {@condition restrained}.

trait.name: Acción Astuta
entries: En cada uno de sus turnos, Hollis puede usar una acción adicional para Correr, Destrabarse o Esconderse.

trait.name: Ataque Furtivo (1/Turno)
entries: Hollis causa 14 ({@damage 4d6}) de daño adicional cuando impacta a un objetivo con un ataque de arma y tiene ventaja, o cuando el objetivo está a 5 pies de un aliado.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hollis realiza tres ataques con sus dagas envenenadas.

action.name: Daga Envenenada
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

reaction.name: Esquiva Asombrosa
entries: Hollis reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de un ataque que pueda ver.
